# Numerical fixtures

`paper_candidates.parquet` contains eight actual synthetic benchmark candidate rows with reference trajectory and image features. `paper_tracks.parquet` contains the corresponding observed trajectories. These small excerpts are included so continuous integration can test numerical behavior without downloading the full dataset.

Data copyright 2026 Dai Nakai, licensed under CC BY 4.0, as stated in the [data license](../../LICENSE-DATA.md). Cite the dataset revision and repository version when reusing the fixtures. Software tests themselves use the repository's MIT license.
